# Embedded SQLite

SQLite 3.54.1 amalgamation, copied unmodified from the official [SQLite download](https://www.sqlite.org/2026/sqlite-amalgamation-3540100.zip). The source and header are in the public domain; see their file headers and [SQLite copyright](https://www.sqlite.org/copyright.html).

`provenance.json` records the archive URL and SHA-256 hashes. The official archive SHA3-256 is `92281c86e2957f9b9305890f9ac04204caa7b677cc868dc326d942689df28e30`.

The build compiles this source once with extension loading disabled. No SQLite installation, DLL, or external database server is needed.
